name: ShareReady E1 isolated Rust/WASM feasibility SPIKE
milestones: Original Stage 01 evidence/permissions explicitly preserved, E1 bounds and isolated branch proven
Real opaque pixel replacement + fresh PNG verified against frozen synthetic fixtures
Actual Chromium WASM, download and Clipboard edge paths measured
Independent evidence review and explicit GO/NEEDS_REWORK/SWITCH_HOST/NO_GO technical decision

steps.title: E0 Establish permissioned isolated branch and baseline
steps.done_when: A separate E1 spike branch/worktree exists only after engineering authorization; parent main commit, approved candidate scope, toolchain/versions, and no-product-code baseline are recorded
steps.verify: Review exact branch identity, clean base and confirmed human gate tokens; make no code change before permission

steps.title: E1a Rust opaque pixel geometry and negative fixture tests
steps.done_when: A small isolated Rust crate proves exact half-open region coverage, T01/T02/T04 retained regions and 1px/negative bounds without CSS overlays
steps.verify: Cargo tests and diffed synthetic PNGs, including error counterexamples

steps.title: E1b Clean PNG metadata/format and malformed-input probe
steps.done_when: Rust re-encode exports new PNG without synthetic T05 EXIF/GPS and handles damaged/over-limit PNG/JPEG by explicit errors
steps.verify: Second independent binary check of output chunks, pixels, dimensions and limits

steps.title: E1c Minimal WASM Chromium image-to-output browser trial
steps.done_when: Real Chrome loads standalone WASM page with frozen synthetic input, output PNG generated by Rust core, downloaded and independently reopened; no production app shell
steps.verify: Headless real-browser runner screenshots, network trace, actual PNG digest and source/target comparison

steps.title: E1d Clipboard allow/deny and resource boundary verification
steps.done_when: True Clipboard image/png write and paste-back tested where supported; denied/unsupported cases yield download fallback; resource use and network destination recorded
steps.verify: Actual browser permissions/Clipboard output trace; explicit blocked states rather than fabricated PASS

steps.title: E1e Independent security and architecture decision
steps.done_when: An independent reviewer examines exact code, all test artifacts, license graph and cross-browser gaps, recommending GO/NEEDS_REWORK/SWITCH_HOST/NO_GO; no merge/release
steps.verify: Peer review report with links, measured vs unresolved assertions, and committed frozen input hashes

if_then.if: Opaque pixel coverage or metadata-clean export fails
if_then.then: Stop engineering before UI integration; quarantine failing fixtures and request rework/replan rather than pretending visual coverage proves safety

if_then.if: Browser clipboard is denied or unsupported on one platform
if_then.then: Classify actual support matrix and preserve safe download fallback; do not relax the original pixel/PNG safety contract

if_then.if: WASM heap/performance fails on target test images or memory bounds
if_then.then: Record precise environment and memory limit, propose Tauri/native host candidate with fresh authorization instead of changing architecture unilaterally

if_then.if: Third-party network transmission of image bytes or unauthorized dependency appears
if_then.then: Stop and audit; no release or private input is permitted until explicitly approved

if_then.if: No new evidence of product value appears
if_then.then: Keep Stage 01 user-demand A1 OPEN; technical GO cannot become product release GO

early_signals: T04 one-pixel boundary still leaks at scaled canvas corners
Output JPEG metadata or hidden original data chunks survive PNG conversion
Clipboard UI says copied while permission was rejected
Rust/WASM candidate crashes or allocates beyond explicit input bounds
A runner performs any Rust code change before explicit Gate B + engineering authorization
